title: Review findings: strict-YAML frontmatter gap and CI-7 coverage below 90
context: Review of the ChatGPT directory change found two major issues. (1) Three published SKILL.md descriptions (sources: skills/product-discovery, skills/ground-in-project, skills/front-door, line 3) contain ': ' in an unquoted value. PyYAML safe_load rejects all three. The check's minimal reader (build/check_chatgpt_submission.py:673) accepts them, so the check passes a zip the portal may reject. (2) CI-7 coverage is 86 percent against the 90 percent gate (AC-17). HEAD is 82 percent, so this is not a regression.

options.label: Quote the three descriptions, make the check reject ': ' and ' #' in plain values, and add tests to reach 90 percent coverage
Quote the three descriptions and tighten the check now; accept CI-7 coverage as a pre-existing gap (ratchet exception)
Ship as is and record both as known risks

rationale: Owner chose fix-both: quote the 3 descriptions, tighten the check (': ', ' #', trailing ':', '.' segments, duplicate entries), and add tests to older scripts to reach the 90% CI-7 bar.
